content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the UP Excise Constable (Aabkari Sipahi) Exam City Details and related Mains examination schedule under Advt. No. 08-Exam/2026.

The recruitment is for about 820 posts, and candidates who cleared the eligibility result are now checking the examination city details and related admit card / fee instructions on the official UPSSSC portal.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 04/06/2026
  • Last Date for Registration: 24/06/2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 24/06/2026
  • Correction Last Date: 01/07/2026
  • Eligibility Result Available: 28/07/2026
  • Exam Date: 20/09/2026
  • Exam City Available: 11/09/2026
  • Admit Card Available: Before Exam

Use the official UPSSSC portal to download the examination city notice and verify your roll number / exam district. Download the exam city slip, confirm your centre and follow all instructions before the main examination.
